title: A "Magical Pass" that gives entry to the Mall World

classification.theory_summary: Claims a specific series of waking physical movements (“magical pass”) can produce entry to “the mall world”/an “alien shopping mall” and other effects; includes warnings about not touching/taking items.
classification.skip_reason: No concrete dream narrative with describable locations/events; post is primarily technique/theory/claims plus a cartoon and external video link.

meta.author_theory: Describes a waking “magical pass” (series of movements) said to reliably produce vivid ‘magic’ and entry to an ‘alien shopping mall’/‘mall world’ without sleeping; warns not to touch/take items in ‘spirit realms’ to avoid getting stuck or taken.

extraction.extraction_notes: Image content not viewable here beyond being referenced as a ‘quick cartoon’; no describable dream scene layout provided in text. Temporal-like claims present (‘lost… for a day or two’, ‘back home in a few hours’) but not anchored to a specific dream report.
